fit: mango stem-bark blend and exercise performance in healthy men
assessment: Bench-press maximum and repetitions improved in some comparisons. Day-56 adjusted differences versus one-set placebo were +10.6 and +13.8 kg. Stem bark was combined with a flower extract; no mango fruit or validated fatigue scale. The 2021 conference member is likely the same study.

fit: equal corn-oil carrier in an overnight crossover and objective sleep measures
assessment: In 26 healthy completers, corn-only versus drug-in-corn sleep latency was 13.4 versus 9.8 minutes and wake after sleep onset 46.2 versus 47.10 minutes. Both were inconclusive. PSQI was a screening measure. No oil-free phase, refined grade or Parkinson insomnia diagnosis.

fit: topical corn-oil-containing comparator and global sleep quality after herpes zoster
assessment: Comparison-arm mean PSQI 7.83 to 6.25 versus 7.88 to 4.35 in the active arm. Adjusted treatment-comparison difference -1.95 with 95% CI -3.18 to -0.72. Multiple co-ingredients and topical exposure prevent a dietary or independent refined-oil inference.

fit: planned adolescent sleep measures with a mixed oil placebo containing corn oil
assessment: The protocol names a 64-participant sleep substudy. Neither the official registry nor the accessible thesis yields verified arm-specific sleep outcomes. Four oils, unspecified corn processing and a non-Parkinson population limit correspondence.
